versions.description_html:
A session host can quietly go bad, and nobody notices until users stop connecting. This episode explains how Nerdio Manager's auto-heal spots broken Azure Virtual Desktop session hosts and repairs them automatically, and where it can go wrong.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a broken session host actually looks like
  • The health signal Nerdio Manager watches
  • What auto-heal does, from restart to re-create
  • Where you turn it on and what you configure
  • How to see it work in auto-scale history
  • When to use it, when not to, and the mistakes that bite admins

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
